story.so_that: I can track my financial activity and maintain an accurate account balance
story.i_want: view my transactions, add new transactions, and see my current balance in a secure banking application

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Display existing transactions for logged-in account
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user is logged in When they view the transaction list Then they see all transactions impacting their account sorted by date descending

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Show only transactions that impact the current user's account
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given multiple accounts exist in the system When a user logs in Then they see only transactions where their account is involved
Given 5 accounts exist (A-E) When a user logs in with Account B credentials Then they access Account B and see only Account B transactions

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: System handles up to 50-100 transactions displayed at once
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given an account has 100 transactions When the user views the transaction list Then all 100 are displayed without pagination and load time is under 2 seconds

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: System handles 5,000-10,000 transactions in common transaction log
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the system contains 10,000 transactions across all accounts When queries are executed Then response time is under 3 seconds

related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given a new account with zero transactions When a user logs in Then they see empty transaction list with message 'No transactions yet'

related_edge_cases.criterion: Multiple users accessing same account simultaneously
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given two users are logged into the same account When one adds a transaction Then the other sees the updated balance after refresh

related_edge_cases.criterion: Database connection failure during transaction creation
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given database is unavailable When a user attempts to add a transaction Then error message 'Service temporarily unavailable' is displayed
